evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation provider integration evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Provider state, effective period, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Mocked provider result is not provider integration evidence is not operational proof.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation operational evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Telemetry emitted is not alert delivered is not incident handled.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation recovery evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Exercise scope, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Restore completed is not service recovered is not business reconciled.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation training and competence evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Training delivered is not competence demonstrated.

evidence_requirements.title: Affiliation adoption evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Onboarding completed is not sustained adoption.
